flora: Dense thicket of Giant Horsetails (standing straight up like green pipes)
Water lilies (from your previous Jiufotang additions) in the foreground
River mist and soft mud banks
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; creating a 'hall of mirrors' effect with the vertical stalks; atmospheric and damp feeling.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle view looking through a dense stand of horsetails. The stalks create a strong vertical rhythm. In the foreground, the muddy riverbank meets the water where lilies float. The background is soft and hazy with river mist.
visual_logic.ground: Very wet, dark brown mud with small puddles and patches of bright green moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Cool, misty morning light that makes the green of the stalks look neon and vibrant against the dark mud.
